_notes: Checked against the live site on 2026-10-24 by driving each action without a model.

page_extractor: the cart page no longer exposes 'Remove <item>' links in its accessibility tree, so view_cart returned no cart_items. On /cart the extractor now also reads Shopify's /cart.js and returns cart_item_count and cart_lines (name, quantity, line_price). The /checkouts/ branch is the March extractor unchanged.

context_extractors: the March server never ran them. cart_badge used 'link[name^=Cart]' (an accessibility-tree notation that matches nothing as a selector); it now reads #cart-icon-bubble. bundle_progress ('generic:has-text(Add)') could not match anything and is removed.

actions.next_page / prev_page: the March selectors are 'link[name="Next"]' (accessibility-tree notation, matches nothing as a selector) and the text 'Next', but the pagination arrows carry no text, only aria-label 'Next page' / 'Previous page'. A css fallback on that aria-label is added after the March ones.

Not fixed: remove_from_cart. As of 2026-10-24 the /cart page lists no line items at all (only the subtotal); the only remove control is a hidden <cart-remove-button> inside the cart drawer, and the March selectors (a[href*=quantity=0]) match nothing. Fixing it means rewriting the action to go through the drawer, so it is left as March wrote it and fails on the live site.
Not fixable in the mapping: the SPRING promo code is rejected by the site as of 2026-10-24 ('Enter a valid discount code or gift card'), so vhlistings_bundle_promo cannot pass today on either arm.
page_extractor: async () => { try { if (location.href.indexOf("/checkouts/") !== -1) { var txt = document.body.innerText; var discountApplied = txt.indexOf("Order discount") !== -1; var savingsI = txt.indexOf("TOTAL SAVINGS"); var savings = savingsI >= 0 ? txt.slice(savingsI, savingsI + 35) : null; return { discount_applied: discountApplied, savings: savings }; } if (location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") === "/cart") { var c = await (await fetch("/cart.js", { credentials: "same-origin" })).json(); return { cart_item_count: c.item_count, cart_lines: (c.items || []).map(function (i) { return { name: i.product_title, quantity: i.quantity, line_price: "$" + (i.final_line_price / 100).toFixed(2) }; }) }; } return null; } catch (e) { return null; } }
